entities.name: Boreal Glacier
entities.description: One of the four great glaciers covering parts of Terisiare during the Ice Age; the smallest and least destructive.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: A continent on Dominaria covered in glaciers during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Terisiare lies.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: A keep from which the Boreal Glacier was visible.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: He showed Jodah the view of the Boreal Glacier from Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Shown the glacier view by Lim-Dûl during his stay at Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Frost Marsh
entities.description: A soggy, blackened swamp formed by the glacier at the base of the keep.

entities.name: Balduvian Steppes
entities.description: Land partly cut off by the Boreal Glacier.

entities.name: Balduvia
entities.description: A newly forming nation to which part of the Steppes became inaccessible.

entities.name: The Boreal
entities.description: An isolated spur of the Balduvian Steppes cut off by the glacier, later covered by the Sea of Laments.

entities.name: Cult of Rimewind
entities.description: A cult that made its home in the Boreal.

entities.name: Rimewind Keep
entities.description: A keep built by the Cult of Rimewind in the coldest part of Terisiare.

entities.name: Yavimaya River
entities.description: A river fed by the Boreal Glacier.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: The event during which the Boreal Glacier retreated fully.

entities.name: Sea of Laments
entities.description: A sea that rose over the Boreal and Rimewind Keep.

events.summary: The Boreal Glacier cut off part of the Balduvian Steppes, creating the Boreal, home to the Cult of Rimewind.
events.quote: This isolated spur of land became known as the Boreal and became home to the Cult of Rimewind

events.summary: During the Flooding of Terisiare the Boreal Glacier retreated fully and the Sea of Laments covered the Boreal and Rimewind Keep.
events.quote: The Sea of Laments rose over the land, covering the Boreal and Rimewind Keep fully.

relations.note: One of four great glaciers covering parts of Terisiare.
relations.quote: The Boreal Glacier was one of the four great glaciers covering parts of Terisiare during the Ice Age on Dominaria .
who built Rimewind Keep in the very coldest part of Terisiare
